--findall.help: Find all WAFs which match the signatures, do not stop testing on the first one

--format.help: Force output format to csv, json or text.

--headers.help: Pass custom headers via a text file to overwrite the default header set.

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--input-file.help: Read targets from a file. Input format can be csv, json or text. For csv and json, a `url` column name or element is required.

--list.help: List all WAFs that WAFW00F is able to detect

--noredirect.help: Do not follow redirections given by 3xx responses

--output.help: Write output to csv, json or text file depending on file extension. For stdout, specify - as filename.

--proxy.help: Use an HTTP proxy to perform requests, examples: http://hostname:8080, socks5://hostname:1080, http://user:pass@hostname:8080

--test.help: Test for one specific WAF (use --list to get names, quote names with spaces e.g. "AireeCDN (Airee)")

--timeout.help: Set the timeout for the requests.

--verbose.help: Enable verbosity, multiple -v options increase verbosity

--version.help: Print out the current version of WafW00f and exit.
